description: Exact support: sums, supplier, local histories and saved-r9 cases. Slot components and whole-vector counts are separate. Denominators follow the named quantity; a frozen supplier is not the same as an approximate sums output. Saved-r9 rows are constructed historical failing renderings, not new random samples. Missing local-history audits are not zero errors. Analytical reduction only; exact per-cell and per-update rows remain released. Detailed records: paper/data/release/appendix_B_support.json.gz (schema and SHA-256 in release/index.json).
